_comment: Atlas classifications, glossary and Ranger tag masking for the rsingh_gdl_* databases, applied by scripts/governance.py. Only GDL_* classifications and rsingh-gdl-* policies are created or changed; the PII_* tags and policies of the other projects are left alone.

GDL_PII_LAST_4.description: Identifier (PAN, Aadhaar, mobile, account number): masked users see the last 4 characters

GDL_PII_HASH.description: Name or e-mail: masked users see a hash, so joins and counts on it still work

GDL_PII_REDACT.description: Postal address or a raw date-of-birth string: letters become x, digits n

GDL_PII_YEAR.description: Date of birth (DATE column): masked users see 1 January of the year

GDL_PII_NULL.description: Raw binary content of a document (e-mail, KYC scan): masked users see NULL

masking._comment: rsingh is in no masking policy and sees clear values

glossary.name: GDL Banking KPIs
glossary.description: Certified banking KPIs of the General Data Lakehouse. Each term is defined once (config/kpi.json) and assigned to its certified semantic view and to every MIS and regulatory dataset that reads it.
